==Description==
[[File:CommunicationWheel.png|thumb|150px]]
The '''Communication Wheel''' is a feature which allows players to easily communicate between each other. As this option is meant for multiplayer, it will not appear in solo matches. The option will appear next to the consumables on desktop while on mobile, it will appear on the right side of the screen. The default keybind to access it on desktop is N, though this can be changed in the [[Settings]].

When used, a wheel will pop up with various options. These will often allow the player to pick which player to communicate with and what specific action they should take. In some cases, this will require the player to select something or a spot on the map. Once done, a message will appear on the player's bottom right corner informing them of the request. It is possible to hide suggestions in the [[Settings]].

Indicators placed on the map stay there until the message associated with them is interacted with, or if a two minute timer runs out. The name of the player requesting something will be listed in the message and next to the timer. The color used by the game for the player is the same as their name color in chat.

==Options==
===Use Consumable===
[[File:Consumables.png|125px|thumb|Use Consumable]]
''Use Consumable'' allows the player to pick from any other player in the match and request them to use a consumable they have equipped. This option can also be used to view the consumables of other players.

The player receiving the suggestion will simply get the option to press ok.

===Use Ability===
[[File:CommunicationWheelAbility.png|125px|thumb|Use Ability]]
''Use Ability'' allows the player to pick from any other player in the match and request them to use an ability. It is not possible to select which tower should use the ability. The option to pick an ability is not available until a tower which has the ability unlocked is placed down.

The player receiving the suggestion will simply get the option to press ok.

===Upgrade Tower===
[[File:Cooldown Icon.png|125px|thumb|Upgrade Tower]]
''Upgrade Tower'' allows the player to pick from any tower and request the person who placed it to upgrade it. The tower can be selected and it will be shown off with an indicator.

The player receiving the suggestion will be able to view the suggested spot or just accept the message.

===Sell Tower===
[[File:Cash Icon.png|125px|thumb|Sell Tower]]
''Sell Tower'' allows the player to pick from any tower and request the person who placed it down to sell it. The tower can be selected and it will be shown off with an indicator.

The player receiving the suggestion will be able to view the suggested spot or just accept the message.

===Place Tower===
[[File:PlacementLimit.png|125px|thumb|Place Tower]]
''Place Tower'' allows the player to pick from any other player in the match and request them to place down a tower in a specific spot. The spot can be picked by the player and it will be shown off with an indicator. This can also be used as an alternative method of checking another player's loadout.

The player receiving the suggestion will be able to view the suggested spot or just accept the message.

==Trivia==
*The '''Communication Wheel''' was added most likely in response to the Roblox chat update that was released on the 7th of January, 2026, which made it difficult for players to communicate strategies when playing in matches with others outside of similar age groups.
